बॉक्स ऑफिस पर क्रिस्टोफर नोलन का जादू रुकने का नाम ही नहीं ले रहा है! 🔥

17 July को रिलीज हुई Hollywood फिल्म The Odyssey ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर 100 दिन पूरे कर लिए हैं और $1.8 Billion की ताबड़तोड़ कमाई कर ली है। 🎬

Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway और Zendaya स्टारर इस फिल्म ने अकेले IMAX से 555 Million Dollar कमाए हैं, जो Avatar के रिकॉर्ड से दोगुना है। 💥

625.5 Million Dollar की डोमेस्टिक और 1.17 Billion Dollar की इंटरनेशनल कमाई के साथ यह दुनिया की अब तक की सबसे बड़ी R-rated फिल्म बन गई है। 💸

ट्रोजन वॉर के बाद ओडिसियस के खतरनाक सफर की यह कहानी Christopher Nolan के करियर की सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली फिल्म बन चुकी है। 🚀

क्या आपने The Odyssey फिल्म IMAX में देखी है? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 🍿

ctx.title: The Odyssey Worldwide Box Office: Hits The $1.8 Billion Mark, Continues Its Extraordinary Run in IMAX!
ctx.summary:
Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey has set an all-time record with its IMAX collections. The film has had a strong weekend overseas.  
 The post  The Odyssey Worldwide Box Office: Hits The $1.8 Billion Mark, Continues Its Extraordinary Run in IMAX!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Even three months after its theatrical release, Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey continues to create records. The film was recently re-released on IMAX screens after briefly losing shows to new releases. While the film has already doubled the record set by Avatar, it is now registering another milestone in the premium screen format.
The epic, starring Matt Damon in the lead, is out there making history on IMAX screens. It has now become the first film to set an all-time record for IMAX collections. The film, which boasts actors like Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Tom Holland and Zendaya, has earned $555 million solely from IMAX screens worldwide. It has more than doubled the previous record holder, Avatar’s entire IMAX run.
The Christopher Nolan epic recorded his biggest opening and became his highest-grossing movie ever. The film has already completed 100 days at the box office. The film has wrapped up its domestic run with a cumulative total of $625.5 million , accounting for 34.8% of its worldwide total.
The film’s international total stands at $1.17 billion , accounting for 65.2% of its global earnings. On its 16th weekend, the film earned $2.7 million overseas. Currently, the film’s worldwide total stands at $1.8 billion . A significant chunk of the film’s earnings comes from premium IMAX screens.
The Odyssey’s IMAX collection has contributed a massive chunk to the format’s 2026 earnings. The format is on a record-breaking streak this year. It has already witnessed its highest-grossing year ever and is looking to enhance its collections with upcoming releases. IMAX screens will be a primary platform for the upcoming Indian film Ramayana and Hollywood releases Godzilla Minus Zero and Dune: Part Three. All of this is set to contribute to a massive total for IMAX screens worldwide.
The mythological epic has earned more than $1.8 billion at the worldwide box office. It is the all-time highest-grossing R-rated movie worldwide. The film follows Odysseus as he embarks on a perilous journey back to Ithaca after the Trojan War, facing formidable mythical creatures, including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the enchanting Sirens, and the nymph Calypso, as he struggles to return home. The film was released on July 17.
